name: Alabama contractor roster verifier

product.purpose: Return dated exact matches from an Alabama contractor roster export supplied by the Actor user. Report missing or stale records as uncertainty; do not make legal or quality determinations.

your_steps.title: send the ready pilot pitch
your_steps.when: when you want to test buyer interest
your_steps.detail: Choose a municipal purchasing or public works contact from prospects.csv, confirm its public contact channel, and send the draft email in PILOT.md. The pitch tests interest only; it does not promise that the board's search is official or that the product is cleared for sale.

launch_gates: Before processing or reselling any Alabama roster, the owner must ask the board whether a downloadable roster/export exists and whether automated reuse and commercial redistribution are permitted. Until then, use only a buyer-supplied export the buyer is authorized to use.
The owner reviews source wording, price, Apify event settings, and the first Store publication before any listing is published.
